description: Land Title Settlement Department - Welhella, Warakapola D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610135 (23/1002)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the Commissioner's determination regarding title to specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 1:4, 1:5, 1:6, 1:8, and 1:12) in Welhella village. The content includes detailed land particulars, cadastral map references, and ownership details (all parcels owned by "The State"), which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined for Type 4 classification.
